question: रीना सुबह (Morning) सूरज (Sun) निकलने पर क्या करती है? 🌅
explanation: Yay! Reena wakes up early in the सुबह (Morning)! ☀️
hint: You open your eyes and leave the bed.

question: रीना अपने दांतों (Teeth) को कैसे साफ (Clean) करती है? 🦷
explanation: Super star! We must do मंजन (Brushing) to keep teeth strong! ✨
hint: You use a toothbrush for this.

question: शरीर (Body) को साफ करने के लिए रीना क्या करती है? 🧼
explanation: Awesome! नहाना (Bathing) keeps us fresh and clean! 💧
hint: You use water and soap for this.

question: नहाने के बाद रीना पानी (Water) किससे पोंछती है? 🧻
explanation: Great job! A तौलिया (Towel) helps dry our body! ☀️
hint: It is made of soft cloth.

question: रीना अपने बालों (Hair) को कैसे संवारती है? 💇‍♀️
explanation: Beautiful! Using a कंघी (Comb) keeps hair neat! ✨
hint: It has fine teeth to part your hair.

question: स्कूल (School) जाने से पहले रीना क्या पहनती है? 👕
explanation: Fantastic! We wear a वर्दी (Uniform) to go to school! 🎒
hint: It is a special dress for school.

question: रीना पैरों (Feet) में क्या पहनती है? 👟
explanation: Perfect! जूते (Shoes) protect our little feet! 🦶
hint: You wear them with socks.

question: रीना सुबह (Morning) क्या खाती है? 🥞
explanation: Yummy! Healthy नाश्ता (Breakfast) gives us energy! 💪
hint: It is the first meal of the day.

question: ताकत (Strength) के लिए रीना क्या पीती है? 🥛
explanation: Super! दूध (Milk) makes our bones very strong! 🦴
hint: It is white and comes from a cow.

question: अपनी किताबें (Books) रीना किसमें रखती है? 🎒
explanation: Awesome! A बस्ता (Bag) keeps our books safe! 📚
hint: You carry it on your back.

question: रीना बस्ते (Bag) में पढ़ने (Reading) के लिए क्या रखती है? 📖
explanation: Brilliant! We read fun stories from a किताब (Book)! 🌟
hint: It has many pages with pictures and words.

question: लिखने (Writing) के लिए रीना क्या इस्तेमाल करती है? ✍️
explanation: Wonderful! We use a पेंसिल (Pencil) to write our names! 📝
hint: It has an eraser at the back.

question: दोपहर का खाना (Lunch) रीना किसमें लाती है? 🍱
explanation: Yay! A टिफिन (Tiffin) keeps our tasty food fresh! 🥪
hint: It is a small box for food.

question: प्यास (Thirst) लगने पर पीने के लिए रीना क्या लाती है? 💧
explanation: Excellent! Drinking पानी (Water) is very healthy! 🌊
hint: It is kept in a water bottle.

question: स्कूल (School) जाने के लिए रीना घर से कब निकलती है? 🏡
explanation: Great job! School starts early in the सुबह (Morning)! 🌅
hint: It is when the sun rises.

question: रीना स्कूल (School) किससे जाती है? 🚌
explanation: Super star! The yellow बस (Bus) takes kids to school! 🏫
hint: It runs on the road and has four wheels.

question: स्कूल (School) पहुँचकर रीना किससे मिलती है? 👧👦
explanation: Awesome! Meeting दोस्त (Friends) makes us very happy! 🥳
hint: They play and study with you.

question: कक्षा (Classroom) में बच्चों को कौन पढ़ाता (Teaches) है? 👩‍🏫
explanation: Fantastic! A शिक्षक (Teacher) helps us learn new things! 📚
hint: They write on the blackboard.

question: कक्षा (Class) में रीना कहाँ बैठती है? 🪑
explanation: Perfect! We sit nicely on a कुर्सी (Chair) in class! ✨
hint: It has four legs.

question: स्कूल (School) में रीना क्या करती है? 📖
explanation: Brilliant! We do पढ़ाई (Studying) to become smart! 🧠
hint: You use books and pencils for this.

question: रीना अपनी कॉपी (Notebook) में क्या करती है? 📝
explanation: Yay! लिखना (Writing) our letters is so much fun! 🌟
hint: You use a pencil to do this.

question: चित्रों (Pictures) में रीना क्या भरती है? 🎨
explanation: Wonderful! रंग (Colors) make every drawing look beautiful! 🌈
hint: You use crayons for this.

question: आधी छुट्टी (Recess) होने पर क्या बजती है? 🔔
explanation: Super! The घंटी (Bell) says it is time for lunch! 🍱
hint: It makes a 'ring-ring' sound.

question: खाना (Food) खाने से पहले रीना क्या धोती है? 🤲
explanation: Great job! Washing हाथ (Hands) kills all the germs! ✨
hint: You use soap and water on them.

question: आधी छुट्टी (Recess) में रीना क्या खाती है? 🥪
explanation: Awesome! Eating खाना (Lunch) gives us power to play! 💪
hint: It is packed in your tiffin box.

question: रीना अपना खाना (Food) किसके साथ बांटती (Shares) है? 🤝
explanation: Fantastic! Sharing with दोस्त (Friends) makes everyone happy! 🥳
hint: They sit with you during lunchtime.

question: खाना खाने के बाद बच्चे कहाँ खेलते (Play) हैं? 🏞️
explanation: Perfect! The मैदान (Playground) is the best place to play! 🏃
hint: It has grass and swings.

question: मैदान (Playground) में रीना किस पर मज़े करती है? 🛝
explanation: Yay! Going high on a झूला (Swing) is super fun! 🌟
hint: You go up and down on it.

question: रीना स्कूल (School) से घर (Home) कब वापस आती है? ☀️
explanation: Brilliant! School gets over in the दोपहर (Afternoon)! 🎒
hint: It is when the sun is very bright and high.

question: घर (Home) आकर रीना सबसे पहले क्या बदलती है? 👗
explanation: Wonderful! We change our कपड़े (Clothes) after coming from school! ✨
hint: You take off your uniform.

question: रीना अपना चेहरा (Face) किससे धोती है? 💦
explanation: Super! Cool पानी (Water) makes our face clean and fresh! 💧
hint: It comes from the tap.

question: थकान (Tiredness) दूर करने के लिए रीना क्या करती है? 🛋️
explanation: Great job! A little आराम (Rest) makes us energetic again! 💪
hint: You lie down on the bed for this.

question: सूरज ढलने (Sunsets) के समय को क्या कहते हैं? 🌆
explanation: Awesome! We play outside in the शाम (Evening)! 🌳
hint: It is the time before night.

question: शाम (Evening) को रीना कहाँ जाती है? 🌳
explanation: Fantastic! A पार्क (Park) is full of green trees and kids! ⚽
hint: It is a place with swings and slides.

question: पार्क (Park) में रीना किससे खेलती है? 🏀
explanation: Perfect! Playing with a गेंद (Ball) is the best exercise! 🏃
hint: It is round and bounces.

question: पार्क (Park) में रीना क्या करती है? 🏃
explanation: Yay! दौड़ना (Running) keeps our body strong and healthy! 🌟
hint: You move your legs very fast.

question: अंधेरा (Darkness) होने पर रीना कहाँ आ जाती है? 🏡
explanation: Brilliant! We must safely return घर (Home) before it gets dark! 🌙
hint: It is where you live with your family.

question: घर (Home) आकर रीना स्कूल (School) का क्या काम करती है? 📚
explanation: Wonderful! Good kids finish their होमवर्क (Homework) every day! ✨
hint: The teacher gives you this task.

question: जब आसमान (Sky) काला हो जाता है, तो क्या होती है? 🌙
explanation: Super! It is time to rest during the रात (Night)! 🛌
hint: It is when you see the moon.

question: रात (Night) को आसमान में क्या चमकता है? 🌝
explanation: Great job! The beautiful चाँद (Moon) glows in the dark sky! ✨
hint: It is white and round.

question: चाँद (Moon) के साथ आसमान में क्या टिमटिमाते हैं? ✨
explanation: Awesome! Little तारे (Stars) twinkle very brightly! 🌟
hint: They look like tiny diamonds in the sky.

question: रात (Night) को परिवार (Family) साथ मिलकर क्या खाता है? 🍛
explanation: Fantastic! Having खाना (Dinner) with family is lovely! 👨‍👩‍👧
hint: It is the last meal of the day.

question: रीना किसके साथ समय (Time) बिताती है? 🥰
explanation: Perfect! We love our sweet परिवार (Family)! ❤️
hint: It includes your mom and dad.

question: रात (Night) को सोने (Sleeping) से पहले क्या करना चाहिए? 🪥
explanation: Yay! Doing मंजन (Brushing) at night protects our teeth from bugs! ✨
hint: You use a toothbrush and toothpaste.

question: सोने (Sleeping) से पहले रीना क्या सुनती है? 📖
explanation: Brilliant! Listening to a bedtime कहानी (Story) gives us good dreams! 🌈
hint: Grandma or Mom tells you this.

question: रीना सोने (Sleeping) के लिए कहाँ जाती है? 🛏️
explanation: Wonderful! A soft बिस्तर (Bed) helps us sleep comfortably! 😴
hint: It has pillows and a mattress.

question: ठंड (Cold) लगने पर बिस्तर में क्या ओढ़ते हैं? 🛌
explanation: Super! A warm कंबल (Blanket) keeps us cozy all night! 🌙
hint: You pull it over yourself when you sleep.

question: आँखें (Eyes) बंद करने पर क्या आती है? 😴
explanation: Great job! Good नींद (Sleep) makes us ready for the next day! 🌅
hint: You rest completely.

question: नींद (Sleep) में रीना को क्या आते हैं? 💭
explanation: Awesome! Sweet सपने (Dreams) are fun to watch while sleeping! ✨
hint: You see these in your head when asleep.

question: रात (Night) खत्म होने पर फिर से क्या आती है? ☀️
explanation: Fantastic! Every new सुबह (Morning) brings a fresh and happy day! 🌻
hint: The sun rises again.
